summary: Your twenty-first Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on images, containers, Compose, health checks and ports with a confidence number, extend your glossary, write an honest list of what you ran and what you did not, count how hard your system is to start now, tag week 21 and plan week 22 (configuration, secrets and a first CI pipeline).

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Write exactly what you ran this week and what you could not run
Start everything from your README and count the terminals, commands and minutes
Error log: group this week's entries into 3 themes and fix the top one
Run git tag week-21, then plan week 22 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the Deployment Mix-up game to the end and see your score
